Sasha (PM): Heads-up  we need a compact prioritization for the Optimize playbook: batching, prefix caching, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts. Three customer asks driving this: reduce token spend, mobile P95 <100ms, and faster regression detection. I proposed 3 lanes (Cost / Latency / Quality) and 4 minimal launch gates. Need buy-in by Friday.

Mike (Eng): +1. Recommend splitting batching work: runtime continuous batching (big cost win, infra changes) vs SDK/client batching presets (low-risk opt-ins). Runtime needs strong tail-latency controls.

Linda (ML): For quant we should ship "safe presets" (fp16, q4a, int8 profiles) with a per-model quality matrix. Start with Llama2-family + two community models. Must build eval harness before any customer rollout.

Anna (Solutions): Customers want a single-line value prop and a one-page migration checklist for Dedicated. Also Console presets: "Conserve tokens / Balanced / Low latency". RetailCo wants ~30% token reduction target called out.

Tom (SRE): Ops note: aggressive batching may spike P99s. Require canary path, per-route P95/P99 dashboards, token-level cost telemetry, and circuit-breaker SLOs. Define explicit rollback triggers.

Sasha (PM): Draft minimal launch gates: 1) Quant perf matrix for top-3 models + docs; 2) Server-side batching policy with canary + SLO override; 3) Prefix caching opt-in with correctness tests; 4) Eval-alerts prototype + runbook and sample policies. Keep gates small so we can ship incrementally.

Mike (Eng): Add measurable acceptance thresholds into the spec: token reduction % (per-customer), P95/P99 latency ceilings, and allowed eval-score delta. I'll propose numbers in the tech spec.

Linda (ML): Use relative, customer-specific quality thresholds (e.g., recall drop <2%) and human-in-the-loop spot checks early on. Avoid brittle global NLP metrics.

Anna (Solutions): I'll map pilot customers: RetailCo=cost-first, AcmeHealth=accuracy-first, MobileApp=latency-first. I'll draft one-pagers and migration notes.

Tom (SRE): Rollout recipe: canary 5% -> 25% over 24-48h, automated rollback if eval-alert rate or P99 delta exceed thresholds. Add a tiny chaos test for prefix-cache consistency.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot created epic RDW-1622 and linked PRD https://redwood.internal/epics/RDW-1622 :rocket:

Sasha (PM): Next steps: Mike+Linda => tech spec + bench plan by Tue EOD; Anna => customer one-pagers; Tom => SLO guardrails + dashboards. Prioritization workshop Fri 11am. Ping here for blockers. :calendar: :+1:
